title: Playboy's Cover Girls 1986 Newsstand Special Edition Vintage Playboy Covers
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy's Cover Girls - 1986 newsstand special edition, "We've uncovered some of our favorites." Original $3.95 cover price (Canada $4.50, U.K. 3.50 pounds).

Features Playboy cover models, with reproductions of classic Playboy covers. Back cover: the May 1964 Playmate of the Year cover.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
